# ECN-2026-050 - Change notice - Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #3

Revision: Rev A  
Plant: P2, line P2-L2  
Equipment: EQ-P2-L2-RR03

Reason for change
- Background: Recent product audits and production feedback identified inconsistent documentation for maximum ring outer diameter capability associated with EQ-P2-L2-RR03. Existing material handling and process planning records referenced differing diameter limits across maintenance manuals and work instructions, which created uncertainty in ring sizing decisions and risk of tooling overload or inappropriate process selection.
- Purpose: This engineering change notice clarifies and records the maximum ring outer diameter capability for Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill EQ-P2-L2-RR03 to ensure process planners, operators, and maintenance personnel use a single authoritative value when evaluating work orders and setup requirements.
- Scope: This change updates the controlled data set used for quoting, job planning, setup checklists, and production verification for items routed to line P2-L2 that require processing on EQ-P2-L2-RR03. The update affects planning, maintenance scheduling, and operator setup procedures where diameter capability is a gating parameter.

Affected items
- Equipment records: The equipment specification sheet and capacity entry for EQ-P2-L2-RR03 maintained in the maintenance system referenced by MM-P2-L2-RR03 will be updated to reflect the clarified maximum ring outer diameter.
- Standard work: The ring rolling setup pages in SOP-P2-L2-05 that reference diameter capability or limits for EQ-P2-L2-RR03 will be revised to align with this notice.
- Safety bulletin linkage: Any interlock or guarding references and risk assessments tied to diameter handling will be cross-checked against SB-1017 to confirm compatibility with the recorded maximum.
- Planning documentation: Job routing templates and quoting checklists that include a field for maximum ring outer diameter when assigning EQ-P2-L2-RR03 will be updated to the value stated below.
- Training materials: Operator training materials that include machine capability summaries for EQ-P2-L2-RR03 will be annotated to reflect the new consolidated value.

Implementation
- Declarative change: The maximum ring outer diameter for Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill EQ-P2-L2-RR03 is 1525 mm. This value is the authoritative specification to be used in all planning, execution, and documentation related to rings processed on EQ-P2-L2-RR03.
- Document revisions: Initiate controlled revision of MM-P2-L2-RR03 to record the value above in the capacity table and equipment remarks. Update SOP-P2-L2-05 to include the value above in the setup acceptance criteria and the pre-run checklist. Include a reference to SB-1017 where guarding or handling limits are cited, ensuring no contradictions exist.
- Implementation steps:
  - Revision owner in Maintenance will update MM-P2-L2-RR03 and submit changes through document control for release.
  - Process owner will update SOP-P2-L2-05 and distribute the controlled revision to the operations group.
  - Safety officer will review SB-1017 cross-references and document any required mitigation or note that current safety controls are adequate for the stated maximum.
  - Production planners will update job templates and quoting checklists in the planning system to use the stated maximum as a gating parameter for assignment to EQ-P2-L2-RR03.
  - Training coordinator will schedule targeted briefings for operators and maintenance personnel to ensure the updated capability is understood and applied.
- Examples and application notes:
  - When evaluating a new job for EQ-P2-L2-RR03, confirm the ring outer diameter parameter on the customer drawing or job specification does not exceed the value stated above. If the required diameter exceeds the value, route to alternative equipment or initiate an engineering review for special handling.
  - For tooling selection, confirm tooling assemblies and backup rolls are suitable for rings with outer diameter up to the stated value and document the verification in the setup record.
  - During pre-run inspection, the setup checklist in SOP-P2-L2-05 shall include a signed acknowledgement that the ring outer diameter does not exceed the value stated above and that handling fixtures are rated accordingly.

Records to keep
- Revision history entries for MM-P2-L2-RR03 and SOP-P2-L2-05 documenting the change and approvals.
- Affected job records and route selection evidence where EQ-P2-L2-RR03 capability was evaluated using the stated maximum.
- Training attendance logs and signed operator acknowledgements that reference the updated capability.
- Safety review notes linking SB-1017 to the stated maximum and any action items closed or deferred with justification.
- Maintenance verification checklist entries confirming that tooling and handling fixtures were reviewed for compatibility with the stated maximum during the next scheduled verification activity.

Approvals
- Maintenance manager: signatory approval for update to MM-P2-L2-RR03 and equipment records.
- Process engineering: signatory approval for update to SOP-P2-L2-05 and process routing.
- Safety: signatory concurrence that SB-1017 controls are applicable or documentation of required mitigation.
- Operations management: signatory confirmation that training and planning changes will be executed and monitored.

Related documents
- MM-P2-L2-RR03
- SB-1017
- SOP-P2-L2-05

Notes
- This ECN is a controlled change. All updates to the cited documents shall be completed and record copies placed in the document control system prior to routing new jobs to EQ-P2-L2-RR03 that depend on diameter capability confirmation.
